attributes.board_name: Florida Board of Veterinary Medicine (Department of Business and Professional Regulation)

rules.alternatives: Voluntary certification through the Florida Veterinary Technician Association (FVTA); its CE rules are not state law.
rules.notes: Florida does not license or register veterinary technicians; no state CE applies. Board FAQ: technicians are not regulated in Florida. 2026 bills to license technicians (SB 1382, SB 871) died in committee on March 13, 2026.
rules.legal_basis: Fla. Stat. ch. 474 (Veterinary Medical Practice) — no technician licence
rules.rule_quote: Technicians are not regulated in the State of Florida.
